summary_brief: 当日开源生态呈现多条高价值技术主线：AI Agent 沙箱化与安全加固（Docker/AgentCore 隔离、凭据掩码、内容指纹审批）成为编码代理走向生产级部署的核心方向；MCP 协议在工具发现、OAuth 最小权限与元数据透传上持续深化；以 CrewAI、gptme、OpenHands 为代表的多 Agent 编排在上下文压缩、异步子代理状态同步等能力上集体演进。同时验证基础设施（Turborepo/Playwright）与可观测性（OTLP、Langfuse）也在同步增强。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 沙箱化执行成为生产级部署的核心范式
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: ClaudeAgent/CodexAgent 全面迁移到隔离的 Docker/AgentCore 沙箱中运行整个 harness 进程，并配套只读文件系统、UID 降权、网络隔离、checkpoint 恢复、Git 仓库固定等能力，标志着编码 Agent 从单机进程走向安全、可恢复、可多租户的分布式执行环境，成为多家沙箱厂商与上游 GPU 供应商（NVIDIA OpenShell）共同遵循的路线。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 凭据全链路安全防护：掩码、轮转与最小权限
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 与 Goose 通过 Noise 传输协商远程执行器凭据掩码并扩展到 Zsh 快照，配合轮转 stdin 临时凭据、MCP OAuth 最小权限 scope、插件审批绑定内容指纹，以及浏览器侧修复代理凭据泄漏，构成了从执行器、协议、插件到浏览器的完整凭据安全防线，是 Agent 可信执行生态的关键底座。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 协议在工具发现、鉴权与动态集成上系统性成熟
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 与 Stagehand 围绕 MCP 展开多项增强：回合内刷新工具目录、保留 tools/list 的 _meta 元数据、区分审批取消原因、OAuth 资源特有 scope，加上浏览器 agent 对 Chromium WebMCP 的适配，说明 MCP 正从基础连通走向企业级的动态发现、细粒度授权与可观测性。

engineering_signals.title: 长上下文 Agent 的上下文预算管理从被动截断走向主动压缩
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: CrewAI 在触达上限前主动摘要压缩历史并覆盖全部选中历史，gptme 引入基于相关性的上下文修剪与 Anthropic 原生压缩，同时 CrewAI 将超大工具结果落地为临时文件制品按需读取，多项目不约而同针对长任务 agent 的上下文溢出这一普遍痛点提供组合方案，预示上下文管理将成为 Agent 框架的标配能力。

engineering_signals.title: 可观测性向 OpenTelemetry 生态统一：Agent、前端、桌面与网关全链路对齐
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Phoenix 服务器日志新增 OTLP 导出器、Codex/Goose 桌面端与 hub daemon 烘焙 OTLP trace 导出并带启动者归因、Next.js middleware 统一单 OTel trace、Langfuse 上报终端失败，连同 Goose 的 W3C 追踪上下文传播，说明可观测性标准正从服务端下沉到客户端、桌面与 Agent 工作流层，形成统一的 OTel 采集底座。

engineering_signals.title: 多 Agent 与 AgentOS 编排走向操作系统化：异步子代理、会话恢复与组织抽象
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 构建了包含 Company heartbeat、playbook、Product Manager、Task 执行的自主代理公司抽象；CrewAI 与 DeepAgents 在主代理侧感知异步子代理的 waiting（等待人工审批）状态；openai-agents-python 强化失败恢复与 Redis 原子压缩，LangGraph 修复 resume 状态恢复，标志多代理编排正在从框架级走向可编排、可恢复、带人工协同的 OS 化基础设施。

engineering_signals.title: 实时语音与决策推理在 Agent 与 Realtime API 上融合落地
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI 为 Live 会话加入类型化 Decisions 参数与确认事件、支持音频 fixture 回放与提示词驱动自定义音色；opencode 新增实验性实时语音会话端点并打通 iOS 语音委托；OpenHands 实现阅读节奏的流式字词淡入，显示实时语音交互 + 决策式推理正成为代理工具与开发环境共同拥抱的新范式。

engineering_signals.title: 官方 SDK 跨语言同步与统一可靠性增强成为供应商标配行为
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 在 Python/TS/Go/Java 四 SDK 同步落地快速回退重试与 thinking 模型 between_tools 能力，OpenAI/Anthropic SDK 同步新增 speed 与缓存参数；openclaw 把插件 SDK 正向库存持久化并开放只读查询端点，说明 SDK 生态正在追求能力对齐、成本精细控制与生态可观测性的三方统一。

engineering_signals.title: 工具链安装与缓存管理的自动化成为跨语言 monorepo 的通用入口
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Turborepo turbo setup 全面托管 Cargo/Go/uv/Bun/Yarn/pnpm/npm 依赖安装与预取并校验锁文件，同时以流水线重叠优化 cache 归档读写压缩；Anthropic SDK 用 workspace Bazel 替代 ICU patch，CLI 运行时（Goose Boa 替换 V8/Deno）向轻量化自主化演进，标志构建与运行时管理正走向统一托管与体积瘦身。

engineering_signals.title: 浏览器与测试基础设施的 Agent 安全与性能双重加固
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Playwright 修复代理凭据泄漏、域名过滤器拦截重定向盲区、trace 敏感值字节级脱敏，并支持 Bun 运行器、CDP 超时与并发 dry-run；Turborepo 封堵 Git 元数据污染与 Windows 路径校验漏洞，浏览器自动化与测试工具在 Agent 化进程中同步强化了凭据隔离、域边界与产物脱敏。

engineering_signals.title: 终端 Agent 的 TUI 交互与控制体验进入精细化打磨期
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 引入可搜索 /config 面板、/presets 提示词预设、/model 与 /permissions 内联切换、OSC 7501 会话状态上报；gptme 重构单轮多步渲染与 TUI 基座；OpenCode 界面推出 /presets，表明主流 agent CLI 都在投入终端高频路径的交互效率与可读性。

engineering_signals.title: LLM 缓存成本优化在 Bedrock/OpenAI 等多供应商链路集体推进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: opencode 让 Bedrock 推理档案 ARN 通过 cacheFormat 覆盖启用 cachePoint 缓存并遵循 Anthropic 缓存格式，OpenAI SDK 为 Decisions 加入 prompt 缓存设置，SDK 层响应速度（speed 参数）与缓存控制同步推出，表明缓存命中优化已成为跨云供应商控制 LLM 成本的主战场。

research_signals.title: Agent 安全审查基准范式：从运行时防护到事后可审计评估
research_signals.why_it_matters: claude-cookbooks 新增面向已完成智能体会话的事后安全审查方法论，结合 60 条模式规则、结构审查与逐会话复核及证据可追溯报告，为 Agent 安全审计提供了可落地的评估基准，与当日大量运行时层安全加固（沙箱、凭据掩码、内容指纹）构成'防护+评估'的双轮驱动。

research_signals.title: thinking 模型工具间隙思考（between_tools）预示推理-工具编排范式演进
research_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 在四个官方 SDK 的能力类型中同步新增 between_tools 字段，反映思考模型可在工具调用间隙进行推理的新能力，标志着'推理与工具执行交替进行'的编排范式正从研究原型走向平台化基础设施，对 Agent 的工具调用策略与延迟控制具有深远意义。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 沙箱化 Agent 架构
release_signals.why_it_matters: ClaudeAgent 和 CodexAgent 新增 sandbox 参数，将整个 Agent 进程运行在隔离的 Docker 或 AgentCore 沙箱中，并支持会话状态跨容器恢复，标志着 AI Agent 从单机进程向安全、可恢复的分布式执行环境演进。

release_signals.title: Agent 沙箱安全加固
release_signals.why_it_matters: DockerSandbox 和 AgentCoreSandbox 提供了只读文件系统、UID 1000 降权、无特权提升、CPU/内存/进程限制、网络隔离等企业级安全特性，为 Agent 在不可信环境中的安全运行树立了新标杆。

release_signals.title: Codex CLI 交互式控制增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 新增可搜索的 /config 面板、即时打断与转向（instant interrupt）、可配置的 leader key 和后台服务重启能力，大幅提升了 AI 编程助手的交互效率和用户控制力。

release_signals.title: OpenAI SDK 新增速度与缓存参数
release_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的官方 SDK 同步新增了 speed 参数、usage.speed、缓存设置等 API 能力，表明模型服务在响应速度和成本优化方面进入了更精细化的控制阶段。

release_signals.title: Agent SDK 结构化输出与权限策略
release_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Agent SDK 新增 per-tool 权限策略（always_ask/always_deny）和结构化输出错误处理，为 Agent 开发提供了更细粒度的安全控制和更可靠的输出契约。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Agents 恢复能力强化
release_signals.why_it_matters: openai-agents-python v0.24.0 大幅增强了失败恢复能力，包括保留已完成的工具输出、持久化待审批历史、原子化 Redis 压缩等，使 Agent 在复杂生产环境中的可靠性显著提升。

release_signals.title: Turborepo 工具链自动管理
release_signals.why_it_matters: Turborepo v2.11.9 引入 turbo setup 和 turbo exec，可自动安装和管理 Node、pnpm、Go、Rust、Python、uv、Yarn、Bun 等工具链，并支持离线安装和锁文件，极大简化了 monorepo 的环境配置。

release_signals.title: Microsoft Agent 框架 Python 3.15 支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: agent-framework 1.22.0 全面支持 Python 3.15，并统一了跨提供商的 content identity、hosted execution 和 stream-merge 语义，为 Agent 开发提供了更一致和前瞻性的基础。

release_signals.title: Cline 云会话与模型目录更新
release_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 推出云托管沙箱会话，并大幅更新模型目录（新增 Gemini 4 Argon 等），反映了 AI 编程工具向云端化和多模型生态发展的趋势。

release_signals.title: gptme 上下文压缩与异常检测
release_signals.why_it_matters: gptme v0.35.0 实现了基于相关性的上下文修剪、Anthropic 原生压缩和异常行为看门狗，为长会话 Agent 的上下文管理和安全性提供了新方案。

release_signals.title: Phoenix 可观测性扩展
release_signals.why_it_matters: Phoenix 新增 OTLP 日志导出和更多模型支持（Muse Wonder、Gemini 4 Argon），强化了 AI 应用的可观测性能力。

release_signals.title: OpenClaw 稳定性与安全修复
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenClaw 修复了 Gateway 在系统休眠后的恢复、Tlon 群组 DM 的权限绕过等关键问题，并发布了 LTS 版本，提升了 Agent 网关的稳定性和安全性。

release_signals.title: LangGraph 状态恢复与 Postgres 修剪
release_signals.why_it_matters: LangGraph 1.2.16 修复了 resume 时的状态恢复问题，并为 PostgresSaver 新增 prune 功能，提升了图执行引擎的可靠性和存储管理能力。

release_signals.title: DeepAgents 异步子代理状态同步
release_signals.why_it_matters: DeepAgents 新增异步子代理状态更新通知和等待人工输入的报告，并支持 NVIDIA OpenShell 沙箱，增强了多 Agent 协作的可观测性和灵活性。

release_signals.title: Goose 可观测性与模型元数据
release_signals.why_it_matters: Goose v1.55.0 新增 W3C 追踪上下文传播、provider x-request-id 透传和实时模型元数据，提升了 Agent 的可观测性和模型适配能力。

release_signals.title: OpenCode 版本线管理
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenCode 1.x 明确与 2.x 版本线分离，避免自动升级到不兼容的主版本，并停止会话分享功能，体现了对用户升级路径和隐私的重视。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai 批量发版 427 个子包
release_signals.why_it_matters: vercel/ai monorepo 当日批量发版 427 个子包（整批 AI 分析降级，仅按版本语义识别 major 跳跃）。

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode
- Added an `Idle compaction` row to `/config` for turning idle compaction off or back on; the notices shown after an idle compaction now say how to turn it off
- Added a notice to `/design-sync` and `/design-login` that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026
- Fixed a "Prompt is too long" error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted
- Fixed requests failing with "diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted" after switching to Vertex or Bedrock mid-session
- Fixed the Read tool loading an image file of any size, or a pipe or device named like an image, entirely into memory; image sources over 128 MB are now refused
- Fixed `/autocompact` and `/effort` saving to the wrong model when a gateway names Opus 4 or 4.1 with a prefix, such as `anthropic/claude-opus-4-1`
- Fixed a prompt cache miss when a tool added mid-session was loaded again through ToolSearch or after compaction
- Fixed `claude plugin` and other subcommands sometimes exiting before a queued settings or config write finished, which could lose the change or leave a `.tmp` file behind
- Fixed plugin marketplaces re-cloning on every refresh, and newly installed git plugins showing version "unknown", when git defaults to the reftable ref format
- Fixed the PowerShell tool not finding commands in a plugin's `bin/` folder, and reporting an error when a search that finds nothing (rg, grep, findstr, git grep) is piped into `Select-Object` or another formatting cmdlet
- Fixed Claude in the desktop app pointing you to claude.ai settings or `/mcp` to authorize or reconnect an MCP server where that option isn't available
- Fixed artifact publishes sometimes failing when Claude sent an empty list of edits, and Claude retrying an artifact update the wrong way after a newer version of the artifact turned it away
- Fixed `classifier_category` missing from OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events for most auto mode classifier blocks, and new `tool_decision` attributes pushing out `tool_use_id`, `tool_source` and `tool_parameters` when `OTEL_LOGRECORD_ATTRIBUTE_COUNT_LIMIT` is low
- Fixed rows in the agents view staying blank after moving down a long list or folding a section
- Fixed `claude remote-control --help` not printing its usage and exiting when not signed in
- Fixed `/design consent` and `/design revoke` suggesting `/design-login` when they fail in a cloud session, where it isn't available; the message now points to claude.ai/design/settings
- Fixed MCP servers showing no tools, or every tool call failing, when the server negotiates protocol version 2026-07-28 but omits `resultType`, `ttlMs` or `cacheScope`
- Fixed prompt suggestions spending usage credits on models your plan pays for only with credits: they are now skipped after a reply billed to credits
- Fixed URLs written in backticks being clickable only on their first row when they wrap; the whole URL is now one link in terminals that support hyperlinks
- Fixed `claude plugin details <name>@builtin` suggesting `claude plugin list`, which never shows built-in plugins, when the plugin isn't found; it now points to `/plugin`
- Fixed an emoji that a link starts inside wrapping one column too wide, which hid it in question previews and turned tables into lists
- Fixed worktree isolation refusing to create or resume worktrees under git 2.56 or later when a stray `.git` file points at a directory that doesn't exist
- Fixed a cloud session's cost and usage restarting from zero after the session resumed in a new process
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches failing with "bad object refs/heads" in sessions that reuse a checkout stored in git's reftable format
- Windows: Fixed every file write being refused or asked about for projects on exFAT or FAT32 drives, including in sessions started with `--plugin-dir`
- Improved startup time with many plugins enabled: plugin command and agent files now take far fewer file system calls to load, most of all on Windows
- Improved auto mode with the server-side classifier: a conversation too long for the safety check is now compacted, instead of every checked tool call being denied
- Improved the message when a background session reopened from another folder has no LLM gateway: it now says why, instead of "Not logged in"
- Changed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions with no permission mode to start in `default` mode on third-party providers, with telemetry off or on a fresh install; `--permission-mode auto` keeps auto
- Changed fork subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) to be on by default in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code, as they already are in the terminal; `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` turns them off, and `claude mcp serve` never offers them
- Changed the desktop app and VS Code to always run the main conversation's subagents in the background, as the terminal does, rather than let Claude choose; a subagent's own Agent calls in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code now run in the foreground by default
- Changed the `← for agents` footer hint to hide 10 seconds after a session opens; the count of agents waiting on you still shows
- Changed where the Claude in Chrome instructions sit in the system prompt so that new conversations can read them from the shared prompt cache
- Changed prompt and agent hooks so that at most 12 of one event run at a time; the rest wait their turn
- Changed the message shown when your organization's policy turns off `/feedback`: it now points to GitHub issues instead of an organization admin
- [VSCode] Fixed text after an unclosed code block in a list showing as plain text while a reply streams, then turning into code
- [VSCode] Fixed MCP server sign-in from the panel opening a broken authorization page when the server URL contains a query string
- [VSCode] Fixed the `@browser` banner saying "Browser connected" when no browser with the Claude extension can be reached
- [Cloud sessions] Added a banner on a routine's page that says why its last run didn't start, such as your organization reaching its limit on concurrent cloud sessions
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed "Rewind to here" failing on every message except the newest in cloud sessions; self-hosted runners need Claude Code v2.1.246 or later
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed the pull request status bar in cloud sessions flipping a pull request with merge conflicts back to ready while GitHub rechecked it
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs showing as Completed after their cloud session stopped unexpectedly, and as Cancelled when archived before they started, instead of failed
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed the diff view in cloud sessions missing changes or failing to load after the session's GitHub repository was renamed or moved
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed a scheduled routine run that failed partway being run again from the start an hour or more later, which could repeat work such as posting the same report twice
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed an open cloud session sometimes not showing messages sent from another device until you reloaded the page or clicked away and back
- [Cloud sessions] Improved the error shown when a cloud session fails to start: it now says "Connection lost" or "Server error" instead of "Something went wrong"
- [Remote Control] Fixed a subagent's pane spinning forever in a Remote Control session after your computer goes offline; it now says Remote Control is disconnected
- [Claude Tag] Fixed "is thinking…" staying up under a mention in a Slack channel or DM after Claude answered it by editing one of its earlier messages
- [Claude Tag] Fixed URLs in code blocks under a numbered or bulleted step of Claude's Slack replies being wrapped in angle brackets, which broke copied commands
- [Claude Tag] Fixed HEIC, SVG, TIFF and BMP images attached in Slack never reaching Claude; they now arrive as files in its working files, like other file types
- [Claude Tag] Fixed new channel managers losing access to Claude in Slack in organizations that restrict Claude Tag by role; the manager role now also grants Claude Tag in Slack
- [Claude Tag] Fixed custom connectors whose MCP servers share one host showing as a single connector in Claude Tag admin settings; each server is now its own connector
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes answering a direct message with "DMs are temporarily unavailable" and dropping it when a single Slack lookup stalled; it now retries first
- [Claude Tag] Fixed direct messages with Claude on a Slack Enterprise Grid ignoring Slack's workspace dropdown; they now run under the connected workspace you last opened Claude in
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack's notice for a channel's monthly spend limit saying a channel manager can raise it; it now names an organization owner and links the usage page
- [Claude Tag] Fixed links in Claude's Slack replies absorbing the closing bold or italic marks, or full-width punctuation, right after them, which broke the link and the formatting
- [Claude Tag] Improved repository search in Claude Tag admin settings to cover up to 100 connected GitHub accounts and find private repositories past the first 5,000 of a GitHub App install
- [Claude Tag] Improved Add place in Claude Tag admin settings to list a channel you type or paste right away, instead of only after your organization's full channel list has loaded
- [Claude Tag] Improved Add > Domain on a workspace's or channel's page in Claude Tag admin settings to be available once that page loads, not only after every channel has loaded
- [Claude Tag] Changed Claude Tag admin settings to organize Claude's access into four tabs: Bundles, Connectors, Skills and plugins, and Channels
- [Claude Tag] Changed the Roles page in organization settings to group the roles created for Claude Tag channel managers in a collapsed section below your organization's own roles
- [Code Review] Fixed Code Review setup not resuming after you leave to connect GitHub; back in admin settings, it now reopens at the repository picker

key_changes: 新增 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL 环境变量，可选择客户端自动模式分类器所使用的模型
修复大量 bug，包括对话压缩时的 'Prompt is too long' 错误、切换 Vertex/Bedrock 后的诊断错误、大型图片文件加载导致内存溢出等问题
改进启动性能：插件数量较多时启动时间显著缩短，尤其在 Windows 平台上
多处行为变更：fork 子代理默认启用、无权限模式的 -p 会话在第三方提供商上默认使用 default 模式、触发器和代理钩子并发上限改为 12 个
大量 Cloud Sessions、Claude Tag（Slack 集成）和代码审查相关的修复与改进
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2.1.302 是一个以修复和改进为主的版本，包含大量 bug 修复，覆盖对话压缩、模型切换、图片加载、插件管理、MCP 服务器、云会话、Slack 集成（Claude Tag）等多个领域。同时带来几项行为变更，如 fork 子代理默认启用、自动模式分类器模型可配置，以及启动性能优化。此外，Claude Design 独立产品宣布将于 2026 年 12 月 14 日关闭。

### Added

- Cline Cloud sessions, rolling out gradually: run a task in a hosted sandbox on a GitHub repo and branch you pick. Turn it on in Settings. Cloud tasks show in Recent and History with their status, notify you when they finish, and keep running after you close your editor.

### Changed

- With no model chosen, the Cline provider now uses Gemini 4 Argon, the new first model in Cline's recommended list. OpenRouter stays on Claude Sonnet 5.5.
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers, and SambaNova now comes from the catalog with MiniMax M3 as its default. The Cline recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, and the Cline free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. OpenCode Go no longer lists MiniMax M2.7. Default models change for Cortecs, CrossModel, Eden AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Ofox, OpenCode Go, and Prime Inference (Gemini 4 Argon), Fireworks AI, Nebius Token Factory, and Requesty (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, NanoGPT, and Nvidia (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), Aixy and Neon (Claude Haiku 5.5), Agnes AI, Ambient, IteraCompute, Poe, Scaleway, and SenseNova. If you use one of those providers without pinning a model, expect a different default.

### Fixed

- Long requests to local models (LM Studio, Ollama) no longer fail after 5 minutes of silence with `terminated: BodyTimeoutError` while the server is still processing a large prompt.
- OpenAI Compatible base URLs are used exactly as entered. A host-only URL like `https://abc.com` used to get `/v1` added silently. Host-only URLs saved by earlier versions get `/v1` added once, so existing setups keep working.
- Images and files attached to an answer to one of Cline's questions now reach the model instead of being dropped.
- When a provider error interrupts a response mid-stream, Cline retries it up to 3 times before failing the turn.
- In JetBrains, the Run task card stays above the Auto-approve bar.
- Auto Compact and its strategy setting sit together again in Feature settings.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
- Plugins now run only in worker threads (the default, `CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=worker`) or in the subprocess sandbox (`sandbox`). The `in_process` mode is removed, along with its silent fallback. A host that ships no `plugin-sandbox-bootstrap.js` fails every plugin load with `PluginBootstrapMissingError`, which names `CLINE_PLUGIN_BOOTSTRAP_PATH`, instead of quietly running plugins inside the hub. The hub daemon's uncaught error handlers are fatal again. The SSH remote hub ships no bootstrap yet, so it reports plugin tools as missing
- Provider errors that arrive after a model stream has started are retried up to 3 times, and the final failure is reported as an error in logs and Langfuse traces. Exhausted retries no longer also trigger the agent's whole-turn retry, so retry budgets don't multiply
- Model request failure logs include the provider's request id
- `setHubDaemonLauncher` lets an embedding host start the hub daemon through a bundled Cline CLI, and `ensureDetachedHubServer` gains a `beforeSpawn` hook that runs only when a new daemon actually starts. The standalone SSH remote helper entrypoint is removed: SSH remotes run the hub through the uploaded Cline CLI
- `NodeHubClient` accepts `resolveConnectionHeaders`, so a remote proxy's WebSocket upgrade can be authenticated with HTTP headers refreshed on every reconnect. It is threaded through `HubRuntimeHost` and `RemoteRuntimeHost`
- `AskQuestionExecutor` may return text and image blocks, so attachments sent with an answer reach the model
- New `buildTelemetrySelfcheckReport` export in `@cline/shared`
- The `cline` provider's bundled default (the first Cline recommended model) is now Gemini 4 Argon instead of Claude Sonnet 5.5, because the recommended list now leads with it
- Refreshed the model catalog (6,862 → 6,952 models). Adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers, and SambaNova now comes from the catalog with MiniMax M3 as its default. The Cline recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, and the Cline free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. OpenCode Go no longer lists MiniMax M2.7. Default models change for Cortecs, CrossModel, Eden AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Ofox, OpenCode Go, and Prime Inference (Gemini 4 Argon), Fireworks AI, Nebius Token Factory, and Requesty (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, NanoGPT, and Nvidia (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), Aixy and Neon (Claude Haiku 5.5), Agnes AI, Ambient, IteraCompute, Poe, Scaleway, and SenseNova

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.93...sdk/sdk/v0.0.94

key_changes: 插件执行模式移除 in_process，仅支持 worker 线程或子进程沙箱，缺失 bootstrap 文件时插件将加载失败
SSH 远程 hub 暂不支持插件（无 bootstrap），相关插件工具被报告为缺失
移除独立的 SSH 远程辅助入口点，改为通过上传的 Cline CLI 运行 hub
模型流中间出现的 provider 错误最多重试 3 次，且不再叠加触发整轮 agent 重试

releases.summary:
# Changelog

## New Features:

- **Sandboxed Harness Agents**: `ClaudeAgent` and `CodexAgent` take a `sandbox=` parameter and run the whole harness process inside an isolated, per-session computer instead of on the host, with session state that survives losing the container, the host or the replica that ran the last turn. No new classes to hold: `ClaudeAgent(id="coder", db=PostgresDb(...), sandbox=DockerSandbox("agno-sandbox:local", network="isolated"))` is the whole setup, and the agent builds its coordinator from its `PostgresDb` on first use. Each turn claims the session through a lease row in the agent's Postgres (`<session_table>_sandbox_bindings`, created on first use), starts compute restored from the session's last committed checkpoint (workspace plus the harness's own conversation files), runs the turn, then captures and verifies a new checkpoint and publishes the run row and recovery point in one transaction. A cancelled or failed turn publishes nothing and the previous checkpoint stays the recovery point. The turn refuses to continue on state it cannot verify: it passes the native conversation id (Claude session id, Codex thread id) committed with the last checkpoint, and a restore that lost it fails with `native_state_missing` before the model runs instead of silently starting a new conversation. Typed harness settings travel to the runtime as JSON; host-only settings (`cwd`, `retries`, `env`, native option objects) are rejected by name at construction. `require_native_resume` and `strict_persistence` are new options on `BaseExternalAgent`, and `agno[claude]` / `agno[codex]` install extras cover the harness SDKs. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/docker/sandbox_claude.py). (#11028, #11043, #11056, #11057)
- **Docker Sandbox**: `DockerSandbox` is the customer-operated provider. Containers run as UID 1000 with a read-only image filesystem, dropped capabilities, no privilege escalation, CPU, memory and process limits, bounded tmpfs for `/workspace` and `/runtime`, no host or Docker socket mounts, and only explicitly configured environment values plus the harness's model API key. Networking defaults to `none`; `network="isolated"` gives a managed bridge with inter-container traffic off, and `subnet=` picks its range. Deterministic session and generation identity reconciles creation races and lost responses; commands are never retried automatically. `pause` / `resume` are provided through the kernel freezer, and `DockerCheckpointTransfer` moves checkpoints in and out. `cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/build_image.py` builds the runtime image. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/docker/docker_execution.py). (#10975, #11028)
- **Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Sandbox**: `AgentCoreSandbox` implements the same contract on AgentCore Runtime, with `AgentCoreCheckpointTransfer` next to the Docker transfer. Each sandbox generation is one AgentCore runtime session in a Firecracker microVM; `create` is idempotent through a session id derived from the namespace, agent, session and generation. A root server on port 8080 claims the microVM, starts the runtime as UID 1000, fences every later operation with the claimed configuration and a random incarnation so a stale handle can never act on a later claim, forwards start and poll calls, and runs commands behind a guard that drops to UID 1000 in `/workspace`. Checkpoints stop UID 1000 processes during capture and restore and move through `InvokeAgentRuntime` in chunks, up to 2 GiB. Pause is not supported and AgentCore session storage is not used. The provider packages moved to `agno.sandbox.docker` and `agno.sandbox.agentcore`; `DockerCheckpointTransfer` now imports from `agno.sandbox.docker`. The runtime also gained two Codex fixes that apply to Docker as well: it creates `CODEX_HOME`, and it logs Codex in from `OPENAI_API_KEY` when no stored login matches, since checkpoints exclude `auth.json`. `cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/agentcore/agentcore_setup.py` builds, pushes and deploys the runtime. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/agentcore/sandbox_claude_agentcore.py). (#11050)
- **Warm Sandbox Turns**: The coordinator keeps a session's computer for `warm_computer_seconds` (default 300) after a turn instead of destroying it: paused on Docker, left idle on AgentCore. The next turn inside that window resumes it and restores nothing; otherwise it retires the old computer and takes the cold path on a fresh generation restored from the checkpoint. The checkpoint is still captured after every turn, so a warm computer is only a shortcut to the state the checkpoint already holds. `metadata.sandbox.resumed` on every completed run says which path the turn took, and `retire_computer` / `sweep_warm` on the coordinator remove computers that sessions never came back for. Live on Docker a warm Claude turn took 4.6 s against 8.2 s cold; on AgentCore 3.3 s against 8.2 s. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/warm_turns.py). (#11088)
- **Sandbox Through AgentOS**: `POST /agents/{agent_id}/runs` for a sandboxed agent submits foreground, streaming and background requests to the durable queue with no new endpoints. An `Idempotency-Key` retry returns the same run, while a different session, input, options or attachment bytes returns 409. Clients reconnect with `/runs/{run_id}/resume` (`last_event_index`) and cancel with `/runs/{run_id}/cancel`, including across replicas: a cancel settled on another replica now records the run as cancelled and keeps the user's turn on the run row. AgentOS fails at startup if a sandboxed agent has no Postgres to coordinate on, refuses the host-local default checkpoint store once a queue worker is active, and validates each sandboxed agent's bindings table at startup and before a submission, naming the remedy for a table from an earlier build. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/docker/sandbox_claude_agentos.py). (#11043, #11105)
- **Attachments for Sandboxed Agents**: `run` / `arun` on a sandboxed `ClaudeAgent` or `CodexAgent` accept `images=` and `files=`, and the AgentOS run route accepts them as uploads. Only bytes cross into the sandbox: each attachment is validated and encoded before any durable write, staged under `/workspace/.agno/uploads/<run_id>/` by the harness's own staging, and kept in the turn's checkpoint so later turns on a new computer can still read it. A request carries at most 16 attachments and 512 KiB in total; URLs, media references, server file paths, audio and video are refused. Queued runs store the attachments with the submission, so a retry sends the same bytes. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/docker/sandbox_attachments.py). (#10990, #11091)
- **Images and PDFs Inline for Claude Code**: `ClaudeAgent` now sends attached images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP) and PDFs up to 4 MiB inside the message as content blocks, the form the Agent SDK's streaming input takes, instead of only writing them to disk for Claude's Read tool. Claude sees the picture directly and never reads the file back, which used to return the whole file as base64 and overflow the SDK's 1 MiB message buffer and the sandbox's 256 KiB event frame for images of a few hundred KB. Whether a file goes inline is decided from its bytes, so a mislabelled file stays on disk for the file tools; other files and larger images keep the Read path. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/docker/sandbox_image_sizes.py). (#11115)
- **Queue Per Session**: Durable background runs on one session now execute at most one at a time, in submission order, for every component. Each ticket carries a store-assigned `session_seq`; a ticket is claimed only while no sibling in its session is running or paused and no earlier sibling is still queued, so waiting tickets spend no attempt and no worker slot. Different sessions stay concurrent within `max_concurrency`. A paused run holds its session, a continued or retried run keeps its place, and a PENDING run poll carries `waiting_on` with the run it is blocked behind. `QueueConfig.queue_per_session` (default on) controls it, external agents are serialized regardless, and `GET /config` reports the effective setting. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/05_agent_os/background_tasks/queue_per_session.py). (#9587)
- **Instant Durable Submissions**: The replica that accepts a durable submission wakes its own queue worker after the ticket commits, so the run starts in milliseconds instead of waiting up to `poll_interval` for the next poll. A saturated replica wakes on slot release, and peers still pick up jobs on their own poll. Durability is untouched: the row is committed before anyone is woken. (#9667)
- **ChartTools**: New toolkit with a single `create_chart` tool that validates a chart payload (`bar`, `line`, `area`, `pie`, `bar-horizontal`, `bar-stacked`, `area-stacked`) and returns a ready fenced chart block for Agno OS to render, replacing the schema prompt users had to carry. Validation failures tell the model what to fix, and the toolkit ships its own instructions, so `tools=[ChartTools()]` is all an agent needs. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/05_agent_os/chart_responses/agentos_chart_responses.py). (#8295)

## Improvements:

- **Durable Queue for Db-Backed and Factory Components**: Background runs on components created through the components API, on version-pinned runs, and on `AgentFactory` / `TeamFactory` / `WorkflowFactory` submissions now ride the durable queue instead of dropping to a detached task on the accepting replica. The accepting endpoint stamps a resolution scope on the ticket (source, owner, version, and for factories the trusted claims and factory input), and the worker replays that resolution at claim time. A factory that reads `ctx.request` on the worker fails the run with a message naming the fix, since the live request cannot ride the ticket. The run read routes for factory runs no longer answer 400 on every poll. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/05_agent_os/21_factories/08_durable_queue.py). (#9796, #11045)
- **Codex Permission Policy Naming**: `CodexAgent(sandbox="read-only")` is renamed `sandbox_mode`, matching Codex's own config key, since `sandbox=` now takes a provider. The old string form still works with a `DeprecationWarning`. (#11043)
- **Sandbox Cookbooks**: `cookbook/frameworks/sandbox/` is split into `docker/` and `agentcore/` folders, each with its own README and test log, covering the provider, checkpoints, the coordinator, recovery, cancellation, attachments, warm turns and AgentOS. `build_image.py` loads the built tag into the image store and verifies it is there. (#11050, #11081, #11105)
- **Gemini Cookbooks**: Updated to the current models and API. (#11038)

## Bug Fixes:

- **Sandbox Checkpoint Restore**: Every second turn in a sandbox session failed with `getent unable to find entry "1000:1000" in passwd database`, because `docker cp --archive` asks the daemon to resolve the container's user as a name. Restore now copies without archive mode and pins every restored entry to 1000:1000 itself. (#11094)
- **Sandbox Store and Coordinator**: A queue cancel racing a worker claim of the same run could deadlock on lock order; the stop path now takes the session, run and binding in the same order as every other store transaction. Sync calls through `DockerSandbox` leaked an HTTP client per call. Cancelled sandbox runs now record the `EXECUTING` cancellation stage the queue expects. A run marked finished between cleanup and commit goes through the stop path instead of leaving the binding in `finalizing`, and long provider calls extend their lease. (#11057, #11092)
- **Sandbox Submissions**: Submitting with a `user_id` to a session created without one, or the reverse, answers 404 before any ticket exists instead of a 500 with a cancelled job left behind. A foreground request whose job failed before its run row existed returns the ticket's error as a 500 instead of a 503 asking the client to reconnect. (#11105)
- **WebSocket Tails**: With a durable queue, a chat client that sent a second message while a workflow run was streaming over the WebSocket stopped getting events for the first run. Tail pumps are now keyed per (socket, run), a re-subscribe replaces only that run's pump, and a socket may attach up to 32 runs. (#11039)
- **API Docs Order**: The FileSystem routes are registered after the Database routes on setup and resync, so the generated API docs list them in order. (#11099)
- **Tests**: The WebSocket factory workflow tests pin the inline path they were written for, after factory submissions started riding the durable queue. (#11106)

## What's Changed
* fix: let db-backed components ride the durable queue by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/9796
* feat: queue per session - at most one live run per session (head-of-line durable claims) by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/9587
* cookbook: update Gemini cookbooks by @Ayush0054 in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11038
* feat: wake the local queue worker on enqueue (durable submissions start in milliseconds) by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/9667
* fix: run factory-backed components on the durable queue by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11045
* feat: add the AgentOS manager by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11036
* feat: add ChartTools toolkit for inline Agno OS charts by @anuragts in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/8295
* fix: keep OS Manager specialists internal by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11077
* fix: keep every run's WebSocket tail alive when a socket submits another run by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11039
* fix: order filesystem routes after database by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11099
* feat: add opt-in Company Products by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11095
* feat: add Company work records by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11097
* feat: add Company playbooks and Product Manager by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11100
* fix: pin the inline path in the websocket factory version test by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11106
* fix: repair Company manager routing, database identity and tool arguments by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11112
* feat: add Company Task execution and attention by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11101
* feat: cascade Company archives and add grouped counts by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11114
* feat: sandbox support by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11028
* feat: session run previews and status filter for the chat tray; queue listing stays admin-only by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/9815
* feat: Release v3.1.4 by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11113


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/compare/v3.1.3...v3.1.4

key_changes: ClaudeAgent 和 CodexAgent 新增 sandbox 参数，支持在 Docker 或 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 沙箱环境中运行完整 harness 流程，具备会话状态持久化和故障恢复能力
新增 DockerSandbox 和 AgentCoreSandbox 两种沙箱提供者，支持会话预热（warm turns）、检查点恢复和隔离网络
沙箱代理通过 AgentOS 队列支持持久化运行，新增附件上传（图片/PDF）、单会话队列顺序执行和即时提交等能力
新增 ChartTools 工具箱，可通过单个 create_chart 工具生成多种图表，替代原有的 schema 提示
修复了沙箱检查点恢复、WebSocket 尾部事件丢失、沙箱提交错误处理等多个 bug
ai_summary.summary_cn: v3.1.4 是 agno 框架的一次重大功能升级，核心亮点是引入了完整的沙箱（Sandbox）基础设施，使 ClaudeAgent 和 CodexAgent 能够在 Docker 或 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 的隔离环境中运行，支持检查点持久化、会话预热、故障恢复和附件上传。同时新增了 ChartTools 工具箱、队列按会话顺序执行和即时持久化提交等多项增强，并修复了沙箱恢复、WebSocket 和提交错误处理等问题。此外，CodexAgent 的 sandbox 参数更名为 sandbox_mode 以匹配 Codex 配置（兼容旧写法并发出弃用警告）。

## Core

### Bugfixes
- OpenCode 1 now stays on the 1.x release line: update checks use only the npm `opencode-ai` latest version, so 1.x installs are never offered a 2.x build as a regular update.
- Upgrading to OpenCode 2 remains a separate, explicit choice through the 2.0 offer in `/update` or `opencode upgrade --major`.
- Fix upgrades for installs managed by yarn.
- Skip 1.x updates for Homebrew Core installs, which now track OpenCode 2, and check tap and Chocolatey availability before offering an update.
- The install script refuses to install 2.x versions.

升级到 OpenCode 2 需要通过 /update 或 opencode upgrade --major 命令明确选择
修复了使用 yarn 管理的安装的升级问题
跳过 Homebrew Core 安装的 1.x 更新（因为其已跟踪 OpenCode 2），并检查 tap 和 Chocolatey 可用性后再提供更新
安装脚本拒绝安装 2.x 版本

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting
- Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI
- Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y
- Added `rows` to a mod's `Input`: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line
- Added `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules
- Added `classifier_category` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`
- Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a `WorktreeCreate` hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits
- Fixed the `fable` (and `best`) model alias erroring on the Anthropic API when the newest Fable model is not available to your organization: Claude Code now retries once on the previous Fable model
- Fixed a misleading "Please run /login" error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed; the error now names the disk and says to delete files
- Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed
- Fixed workflow agents sometimes skipping their step, and the run still reporting success, after reading the harness note that their task text carries no user authority
- Fixed artifact updates being refused where a PreToolUse hook covers Edit or Write; Claude now edits the file and then republishes instead of changing it in the publish call
- Fixed skills and commands with very many or very long argument names stalling for seconds when invoked; only the first 64 names, each up to 64 characters, are now filled in
- Fixed skills, commands and hooks using very large amounts of memory when their arguments fill many placeholders
- Fixed stray characters such as `>0q` covering the folder trust prompt, and `>4m` before the shell prompt at exit, in terminals built on VTE older than 0.53 such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8
- Fixed stray `GOK` text appearing in the prompt at startup in some versions of iTerm2
- Fixed switching to a model whose name contains `application-inference-profile` running your `awsAuthRefresh` command and delaying model-switch hooks when the provider is not Bedrock
- Fixed sign-in refresh timeouts and unexpected sign-outs after a short command such as `claude auth status` or `claude plugin list` exited in the middle of a token refresh
- Fixed a tool call cut off by a message sent mid-turn during its permission check being reported to the model as rejected by the user
- Fixed a case where switching to a model with a smaller context window could spend usage credits on a summary by the previous model without asking first
- Fixed conversations being compacted over and over, on a model you didn't pick, behind an LLM gateway whose responses name a different model than the one requested
- Fixed vim mode sometimes staying in INSERT after Escape on a slow or busy machine
- Fixed Esc discarding a typed AskUserQuestion answer in vim mode: the free-text field now supports vim NORMAL mode, and Esc cancels only from NORMAL
- Fixed the Read tool reading binary files such as .xlsm, .parquet, .epub and .heic as text
- Fixed a Markdown table with only a header row drawing nothing when too wide for the terminal, including in plans on the plan approval card
- Fixed the /claude-api skill saying CMEK external-key endpoints aren't available on Claude Platform on AWS
- Fixed skills no longer being listed to the model after using `/rewind`
- Fixed the compaction row in a resumed session offering ctrl+o for history that is not loaded; it now says where the earlier messages are saved, and also shows in fullscreen
- Fixed the "new task? /clear to save tokens" hint coming back right after you interrupt a response
- Fixed the permission prompt for a plugin or skill hook's `ask` decision not showing which plugin or skill the hook comes from
- Fixed `/diff` not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories when one of its git checks timed out or failed
- Fixed workflow scripts asking for permission or being refused when read, edited or re-run after a Bash `cd` in the same session
- Fixed dim text on the dark ANSI theme and 16-color terminals: faint inside filled boxes, not faint under selection and search highlights, and list descriptions dimmed like other secondary text
- Fixed a mod's `$.model.fork` returning `nothing-to-fork` when called before the first response of a new Claude Code process had finished, as in `claude -p` runs and cloud sessions
- Fullscreen mode: Fixed `/compact` and auto-compact briefly freezing the UI while the visible transcript is rebuilt
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions started from Slack being unable to find or attach a repository when managed settings restrict MCP servers; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep those tools off
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions being reported as having a deleted source branch, and not retried, when an unrelated setup or session failure quoted git's missing-ref wording
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed the log promising a retry of a failed or declined session release for a session that is ending; repeated failures now show a count
- Windows: Fixed stopped background PowerShell commands missing the closing `[killed]` line in their output file
- Improved switching to a model with a smaller context window: a conversation too long for the new model is now summarized by the previous model first
- Improved rendering performance while a long-running subagent works: its progress trail now updates incrementally instead of being reprocessed in full on every render
- Improved artifacts: pages Claude writes now paint the band above a sticky header, so scrolled text no longer shows there in the mobile apps
- Improved mods: in VS Code and the desktop and mobile apps, a tree drawn above the question dialog can now hold Markdown and up to 48 rows; the terminal keeps 12 plain rows
- Changed a mod hook's `.catch` handler to run only when the hook throws or times out; events raised beneath the hook's own calls now skip that hook without asking its `.catch`
- Changed a mod's `$.env.set` to resolve with `{}` once the variable is set or unset, or with `{ deny }` saying why when the write is not made
- [VSCode] Added LaTeX math rendering in Claude's responses, including `$$` and multi-line `\[ … \]` blocks and inline `$…$` and `\(…\)` math
- [VSCode] Added a "Get more usage" link to the usage-limit banner for Pro and Max plans in the VS Code and JetBrains panels
- [VSCode] Fixed a conversation that crashes or freezes the panel being reopened on every reload
- [VSCode] Fixed the chat panel slowing down during long thinking: it no longer re-parses the whole thinking text on every update
- [VSCode] Fixed diagnostics showing "[object Object]" instead of the rule code (e.g. MD013) for some language servers
- [VSCode] Fixed the native dictation audio module being loaded, to check microphone permission, where dictation is not offered (non-claude.ai sign-ins, remote windows)

key_changes: 新增多个功能：OpenTelemetry 追踪配置、vim 模式括号跳转（%）、多行文本输入字段、以及无值守重试模式的超时等待参数
大量错误修复：涵盖 vim 模式、二进制文件读取、工作区/分支切换、权限提示、命令搜索、内存占用等数十项稳定性和正确性问题
新增模型切换改进：切换到更小上下文窗口的模型时，会自动先用原模型对过长的对话进行总结
VSCode 扩展新增 LaTeX 数学公式渲染、使用额度提示链接，并修复面板崩溃、性能下降等问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次版本以大量错误修复为主，同时包含多项功能增强和改进。新增了 OpenTelemetry 追踪记录、vim 模式括号跳转、多行文本输入等实用功能，并修复了数十项涉及权限、搜索、vim 模式、工作区管理等诸多方面的问题。此外改进了模型切换时的对话总结策略、渲染性能以及 VSCode 扩展体验，整体属于稳步迭代的改进型发布。

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added per-tool permission policies to sdk-type MCP server configs: `tools` entries with `permission_policy` `always_ask` or `always_deny`, applied on `initialize` and `setMcpServers()`
- Added `BUILTIN_TOOL_NAMES` and `LEGACY_TOOL_NAME_ALIASES` exports: the public built-in tool names and their earlier names, for checking permission rules and tool settings
- Added `addPlugins` to `Query.reloadPlugins()` so a host can load more plugin folders into a running session
- Fixed `setModel()` with a model ID failing while the account is at its five-hour or weekly usage limit; the model now applies and the next message reports the limit
- Changed the error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed: `error` is now `invalid_request`, not `authentication_failed`, and `api_error_status` is `null`, not 401
- Changed `mcpServerStatus()` to still report a tool's `_meta.ui.visibility` when the rest of its `_meta.ui` fails validation
- Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.301

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.301
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.301
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.301
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.301
```

key_changes: 为 MCP 服务器配置新增 per-tool 权限策略，支持 always_ask 和 always_deny 两种权限模式
新增 BUILTIN_TOOL_NAMES 和 LEGACY_TOOL_NAME_ALIASES 导出，便于检查权限规则和工具设置
通过 Query.reloadPlugins() 新增 addPlugins 方法，使宿主可以在运行中的会话中加载更多插件目录
修复 setModel() 在账户达到使用限额时失败的问题，模型现在可以正常应用
优化磁盘已满时的登录刷新错误处理，将错误类型从 authentication_failed 改为 invalid_request
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次 v0.3.301 版本主要带来多项功能增强：为 MCP 服务器配置加入了 per-tool 权限策略控制，支持随时询问或始终拒绝的工具权限管理；新增了内置工具名称及旧别名导出，方便用户配置和管理权限规则；同时支持在运行会话中动态加载更多插件文件夹。此外还修复了使用限额下 setModel() 失败的问题，并优化了磁盘已满场景下的错误处理逻辑。

## Changes

### PR [#2141](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2141) by [putramkti](https://github.com/putramkti) and [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): fix: handle carriage return input in interactive setup prompts

- Fixed interactive setup hanging when terminals (such as kitty on macOS) send a bare carriage return instead of a newline; prompts now accept Enter reliably.
- Added a `readLine` helper that terminates on either `\r` or `\n`, strips the `\n` from `\r\n` pairs, and shares a single `bufio.Reader` so buffered input is not lost between questions.
- Simplified plugin input handling by removing redundant newline trimming from setup question answers.
- Removed mutex locking from the shared standard input reader initialization.
- Consolidated line-ending tests into table-driven LF, CRLF, and CR cases, replacing the standalone carriage-return and scripted setup question tests.

key_changes: 修复交互式设置向导在终端（如 macOS 上的 kitty）发送裸回车符而非换行符时卡住的问题，现在 Enter 键可稳定生效
新增 readLine 辅助函数，支持 \r 或 \n 作为行结束符，并正确处理 \r\n 组合输入
优化插件输入处理，移除设置问题答案中多余的行尾修剪逻辑
移除共享标准输入读取器初始化中的互斥锁
将独立回车符测试脚本改为表驱动测试，覆盖 LF、CRLF 和 CR 三种情况
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本修复了交互式设置向导在特定终端环境下因回车符处理不当而挂起的问题。通过新增统一的 readLine 辅助函数，现在可以同时兼容 \\n、\\r 和 \\r\\n 三种行结束格式，并优化了缓冲区共享机制。此外，测试结构也被重构为表驱动测试，使输入处理更加健壮可靠。

- Fixes YouTube visual OCR cues so timestamps come from real ffmpeg frame timing instead of the OCR result index.
- Parses `pts_time` from ffmpeg `showinfo` output and formats cue ranges from actual frame times, with a safe fallback.
- Adds regression coverage for the timestamp parser, cue-range helper, and the end-to-end visual extraction path.

releases.summary:
## New Features

- Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)
- Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)
- Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)
- Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)
- Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)
- Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

## Bug Fixes

- Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
- The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)
- Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)
- On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)
- Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
- `codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

## Documentation

- Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
- Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

## Chores

- Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
- Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

releases.summary:
## 2026.10.4

### Highlights

- The Gateway keeps running after the computer sleeps or the system clock jumps, instead of restarting itself because its ownership heartbeat looked stale. (#170790) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway shutdown and restart no longer hang on a stalled transcript worker or in-flight session lifecycle events. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
- Tlon group DMs no longer treat other participants as the owner, closing an owner-impersonation path. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Headless browser pages keep responding to clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
- Manual `/compact` settles the active run before compacting instead of aborting it and dropping the pending request. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.

### Changes

- Stability patch for 2026.10.3 with no new features or configuration changes. Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- Gateway: stays responsive during long reply-tagged streams, and long replies that quote tool-call XML no longer re-parse Markdown on every token. (#166782, #171573) Thanks @boeingchoco.
- Gateway: blocked durable context-engine turns are logged once instead of on every run. (#167595) Thanks @jalehman.
- Control UI: delayed application heartbeats no longer force a reconnect. (#171253)
- Gateway: recover state ownership after sleep and wall-clock changes, and allow `openclaw gateway restart` from verified external macOS terminals. (#170790, #170354) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway: bound transcript-worker shutdown waits and wait for session lifecycle publication during shutdown. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
- Gateway: start enabled standalone plugin files with the Gateway, and keep worker heap limits enforced when the managed service sets a process-wide heap flag. (#171330, #166581) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, @waynegault, and @obviyus.
- Agents: launched plugin turns no longer fail with writer-claim errors, and Claude CLI sessions no longer fork history across message routes. (#170077, #167241) Thanks @cmatrx0.
- Agents: manual compaction settles the active run instead of aborting it. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.
- OpenAI: tool turns for reasoning models on api.openai.com Completions routes no longer fail with a 400. (#166182) Thanks @obviyus and @AsTutoAI.
- Updates: agent databases are no longer flagged as changed during snapshot capture, the success summary stops repeating settled plugin data/settings upgrades as pending, and metadata inventory keeps running under progress-output backpressure. (#170351, #170413, #168493) Thanks @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
- Updates: slow host admission no longer holds the database writer and disrupts Gateway work, progress keeps reporting through temporary Doctor maintenance, snapshot failures get an accurate headline and recovery advice, and Linux updates can clean up abandoned runtime directories under protected systemd user managers. (#171493, #171454, #171457, #171488, #170783, #166335) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @vincentkoc.
- Updates: candidate validation no longer amplifies private SQLite snapshots on live installs, older drivers stop reading candidate-migrated state and stale restart verdicts clear, and optional cron inspection or snapshot cleanup failures no longer stall updates. (#167451, #170130, #170754) Thanks @angeliti999 and @RomneyDa.
- Updates: `openclaw update repair` turns no longer time out before running tools on slower hosts; nested authority checks reuse the current state snapshot instead of copying the database again. (#166847)
- Doctor: updates no longer refuse unreferenced retired OAuth sidecars, and offline state repair works for app-owned Gateways. (#165420, #170768) Thanks @obviyus and @RomneyDa.
- Tailscale: an interrupted start stops its serve process, local access stays available when the tailnet denies Serve, and Doctor checks configured Tailscale startup prerequisites. (#167514, #171509, #166947) Thanks @pandysp and @RomneyDa.
- macOS: app recovery keeps compatible newer Gateways instead of downgrading them, and repair accepts a verified LaunchAgent bootstrap that is already in progress. (#170766, #170740) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Sessions: equivalent POSIX path aliases such as `/tmp` and `/private/tmp` no longer restart channels. (#166462) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star.
- MCP: OAuth login completes when the authorization server registers loopback redirect URIs without a port. (#170876) Thanks @9fw2pq8sgb-art.
- Browser: headless pages accept clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
- Control UI: updated chats recover through the serving document. (#168941)
- Tlon: never treat group DM authors as the owner. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Telegram: polling workers resolve in both source and package builds. (#154286) Thanks @xydt-juyaohui and @markfietje.
- Discord: agent consults keep working after voice changes. (#171029) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star and @brainmonger.
- Feishu: config hot-reload no longer orphans conversation bindings. (#169226) Thanks @ruel225, @junniar, and @obviyus.
- IRC: long non-ASCII replies are no longer lost when the server relays them. (#159730) Thanks @rodricksz4h5.
- Release: plugin npm publish tolerates repeated artifact pagination entries, Linux builds trigger after automatic requests with hosted-runner credentials, and ratchet checks read large Git baselines. (#171044, #167087, #167237, #164743) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.

### Complete contribution record

ai_summary.summary_cn: v2026.10.4 是一个稳定性补丁版本，针对 2026.10.3 进行了大量修复，重点解决了 Gateway 在系统休眠/时钟跳变后的所有权恢复、关闭/重启挂起问题，以及手动压缩命令的行为优化。此外还修复了 Tlon 群组 DM 的所有者冒充安全漏洞、OpenAI 推理模型工具调用失败、多个渠道（Telegram/Discord/飞书/IRC）的稳定性问题，并改进了更新流程的可靠性。

releases.summary:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.10.3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.10.3)

## 2026.9.33

### Highlights

- **Safer September upgrades:** updates on the 2026.9 line keep state, plugin data, service ownership, and Windows state paths intact, and refuse automatic restore over unattributed Doctor writes. (#160167, #166755) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vyctorbrzezowski, @jalehman, @Alix-007, @jayzhou2309, @nitinjwadhawan, @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @taihartman, and @DonnieFi.
- **Updates that finish on pnpm, npm, and Windows:** pnpm 12 Gateway services and launchers survive native updates, retained updater runtimes no longer block npm recovery, and Windows updates no longer roll back after Doctor rechecks driver ancestry. (#170003, #170131, #170170, #169563) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **New model support:** run Meta Muse Wonder, use MiniMax M3.1 thinking effort levels, and stay signed in to MiniMax portal OAuth past token expiry. (#170232, #160089, #160459) Thanks @RomneyDa, @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @masatohoshino, @rongtianhua, @DonnieFi, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **More reliable model turns:** agent runs honor live thinking levels, local providers get response-header deadlines, ChatGPT WebSocket normal closes recover, and Codex replies keep their final tokens. (#168566, #168282, #167512, #168400) Thanks @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @mightyx, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, and @ajmtrz.
- **Work survives Gateway restarts:** interrupted automation turns, steered sessions, cloud worker claims, and partial worker replies now resume or persist after a restart. (#170162, #170252, #170161, #170223) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Delivery and device stability:** live sends survive queue recovery, and node requests no longer fail on unrelated pairing activity or while another device's pairing is written. (#169010, #169486, #169575) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Agent and update stability:** carry a broad batch of compatible October fixes for agent turns, sessions, channels, and update recovery. (#170476) Thanks @RomneyDa, @yetval, @Dimitri-lcht, @Program-123, @dhruv1220, @Shenrui-Ma, @igs-rogenlo, @changeroa, @hxy91819, @Takhoffman, @harjothkhara, @TYY-2005, @giodl73-repo, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jalehman, @wangmiao0668000666, and @an2in.

### Changes

- **Meta:** add the Muse Wonder model to the catalog and onboarding with max thinking support, keeping Spark as the default. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **MiniMax:** add the MiniMax M3.1 Flash Preview model and route its thinking effort levels to the provider. (#160089) Thanks @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **LM Studio:** refreshing saved inventory now discovers newly loaded models. (#168039) Thanks @jb-lopez, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

### Fixes

- **Update and Doctor:** keep Doctor running under unreadable supervisors and child binding errors, keep clean service install refusals out of native-authority recovery, stop update history writes from stalling cron and cleanup, avoid bookkeeping-only repair refusals, and never delete an OAuth profile because the legacy auth store is unreadable. (#169665, #169658, #169283, #170195, #170256) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Yolo521-bot, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Updating from 2026.8.35:** cron jobs approved with "allow always" keep running unattended after the update, pnpm 12 Gateway services left on a deleted store generation are rewritten to the durable install link, Doctor defers optional checks so updates finish under older updaters' time limits, official plugins with removed SDK imports are no longer silently kept, and Kubernetes pods run Doctor before starting. (#171816) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway responsiveness:** long streamed replies that start with a reply tag such as `[[reply_to_current]]` no longer re-parse the whole reply on every delta, which could keep the Gateway busy for tens of seconds. #166781 (#166782) Thanks @boeingchoco and @obviyus.
- **Tailscale:** an interrupted Tailscale Serve start stops its serve process, the Gateway keeps local access when the tailnet denies Serve, and public chat no longer returns 503s right after startup. #167436 (#167514, #171509, #167604) Thanks @pandysp and @RomneyDa.
- **Context engine:** sessions holding an old blocked turn no longer repeat the blocked-turn warning and re-read it on every run. (#167595) Thanks @jalehman.
- **State database:** state reads no longer stay closed until a Gateway restart after a failed state cleanup. Fixes #162085. (#171709) Thanks @RomneyDa and @residentb2b.
- **Update summaries and Doctor:** successful updates stop listing settled plugin data and settings upgrades as pending, optional dreaming-cron inspection or snapshot cleanup failures no longer block updates, and macOS LaunchAgent repair accepts an in-progress bootstrap. (#170413, #170754, #170740) Thanks @RomneyDa and @DonnieFi.
- **Providers:** recover DeepSeek `calls` markup instead of leaking tool payloads, recover Codex follow-up requests after failed thread preparation, and select aliased llama.cpp models while failing setup when credentials cannot be saved. (#169728, #169431, #168232) Thanks @TOMUIV, @jjjhenriksen, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Channels and tools:** channel tools keep working after a config write restarts the account, ACP agents keep plugin and OpenClaw tools when acpx is installed separately, Talk consultations no longer abort right after connecting, and routed turns deliver blocking questions. (#164848, #159396, #164272, #170083, #170039) Thanks @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @ajmtrz, @brokemac79, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, and @mightyx.
- **Automation:** failed one-shot automations always alert, and cron no longer holds the state writer while waiting on host admission. (#169102, #168291) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Release checks:** Windows installer checks tolerate slow `gateway stop` help and surface cleanup errors, packaged checks recover from a busy Gateway port, and extended-stable candidates now qualify upgrades from the previous extended-stable release. (#169567, #170178, #171565) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

key_changes: 新增 Meta Muse Wonder 模型支持和 MiniMax M3.1 Flash Preview 模型支持
大幅增强 pnpm、npm 及 Windows 平台上的更新稳定性，包括 pnpm 12 Gateway 服务更新后保留、Windows 更新不再回滚等
提升模型对话可靠性，包括实时思考级别支持、本地提供方响应截止时间、ChatGPT WebSocket 恢复等
Gateway 重启后自动化任务、会话、云 Worker 任务和部分回复可恢复或持久化
大量更新和 Doctor 可靠性修复，包括从 2026.8.35 升级的兼容性改进、Tailscale、上下文引擎、状态数据库等修复
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2026.9.33 是 openclaw 的 extended-stable（LTS 级别）版本，集中发布了更新稳定性和兼容性大幅改进、新增多个模型支持以及 Gateway 重启后的工作恢复能力增强。同时带来了大量关于模型对话可靠性、更新与 Doctor 流程、Tailscale、上下文引擎和状态数据库等关键修复。
